text.text_excerpt: We happened to visit between two major NOLA festivals so that's why I'm convinced we got a good deal on this hotel. We booked through travelocity and it came out to be about a 100/night. For a suite and the free continental breakfast and its location, it's an awesome deal. We checked in quickly and were sent up to our room. No view unfortunately - we faced this inside rectangular space of the hotel. It's kind of a waste - they could put in a swimming pool or garden or a mini golf course. Anyways, like I mentioned before the room is a suite. Small living room area with a TV, couch, desk, closet and mini bar area with a sink, fridge and coffee maker. Then there's a bathroom - spacious enoug...

I booked this hotel through Expedia mainly because I got a fantastic deal. I figured I couldn't go wrong since it served complimentary breakfast and was operated by the Ritz Carlton. Boy, was I right! Everyone was super friendly, from the front desk staff to the bellhops to the cleaning staff. Our room was spacious since it is a suite - rather large living room area with sofa bed, desk, and tv and large bedroom with king size bed and another tv. There was also a small refrigerator and mini bar area. The bathroom was a bit snug even for two people, but the fixtures and bath products are nice. Our view was of the city above the French Quarter so not much to see, but I would rather see nothi...

We were here for the Southern Decadence/ Labor Day Weekend and got a good deal on hotels.com. The rooms are very comfortable and large: sitting area w/TV and fold-out sofa, wet bar w/ refrigerator, king-size bed and another TV, smallish but serviceable bathroom without a lot of counter space. Overall, it was a great value. The furnishings were old, cigarette burn hole in the sofa, another cigarette burn on the blanket. Our porter told us the whole place was getting a major renovation from Marriott. The hotel is in a great location. In the French Quarter, but far enough from the crowds. And at the Iberville suites you get to use the facilities of the Ritz-Carlton next door. There's a break...
